```python
import cyclopts

def status():
    """Show the current status."""
    print("Status: Everything is running smoothly!")

def start():
    """Start the service."""
    print("Service started!")

def stop():
    """Stop the service."""
    print("Service stopped!")

app = cyclopts.App(default=status)
app.command(start)
app.command(stop)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    app()
```
